risk_note: RV2 by path. Production wiring of the rebate port and the blacklist step (D10-548, D10-550, D10-551): settlement's createRebatePort replaces the PENDING_SETTLEMENT stub on the order worker, through one factory that B1-10n reuses, with commission's estimates and admin's transactional system audit; orderSyncPorts gets risk's blocklist ports. From here synced orders leave UNATTRIBUTED. Assembly only: no settlement, commission or risk internals change, no contract, no migration. Clawback routing stays with B1-10n. A missing field keyring skips the blacklist step in local and test and refuses to start elsewhere. Known and recorded: pdd estimates shown to users overstate the service fee from here on (FU-PDD-NET-N); config reads take a second connection inside the order lock, as orderSourcePorts already does.
